def_en: 1) to pull out, pull up, set out, journey, remove, set forward, depart
1b) (Niphal) to be pulled up, be removed, be plucked up
1c1) to cause to set out, lead out, cause to spring up
kjv: cause to blow, bring, get, (make to) go (away, forth, forward, onward, out), (take) journey, march, remove, set aside (forward), [idiom] still, be on his (go their) way.
expl: properly, to pull up, especially the tent-pins, i.e. start on ajourney
